notes: This is an initial cross-machine regression guard reviewed from three local WSL Node 22 linux-x64 runs, not a multi-run hosted-CI calibration.
Ingest and Ledger limits use rounded headroom above twice the observed maximum; replay uses a conservative one-second ceiling for cold filesystem variance.
Deterministic size limits use the next practical binary boundary above the observed maximum: 2048, 2048 and 4096 bytes.
The ingest limit includes one durable append and fsync per event; the Ledger transition limit excludes that I/O.
Correctness invariants and exact replay remain mandatory even when latency is within limits.
Runtime reroute, semantic-call and Reflection counters are enforced by the real Runtime integration test, not inferred from this Store/Ledger benchmark.
